de1.P1.C1.ly_do: Ham bac nhat dang $y=ax+b$ voi $a\ne 0$: chi $y=-x+1$ thoa; $y=0x+1$ la ham hang, $y=x^2$ bac hai, $y=\sqrt{x}+1$ khong phai bac nhat.

de1.P1.C12.ly_do: Dinh li duong phan giac trong tam giac MNP: $\frac{EN}{EP}=\frac{MN}{MP}$; E khong nhat thiet la trung diem, khong co $ME=NP/2$ hay $MN=MP$.
